title: iniBuilds Global Jet – Official Trailer and Major Features Revealed
summary: iniBuilds has unveiled the official Global Jet trailer for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, showcasing advanced Vision Flight Deck avionics, detailed aircraft systems, interactive cabins and authentic BR710 engine sounds.
body:
iniBuilds has released the official trailer for its highly anticipated **Global Jet** for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, alongside an extensive preview of the aircraft's advanced avionics, systems and interactive cabins.

[Official Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=98jpS1IHHYU)

Following its initial unveiling at FSimUK, the latest announcement provides the most detailed look yet at what pilots can expect from this long-range business jet.

### Advanced Flight Deck and Avionics

![](/assets/GlexTrailer1.png)

The customised **Vision Flight Deck** features extensive flight management capabilities, including SimBrief integration, multi-leg flight planning, holding patterns, lateral offsets and pilot-defined waypoints.

Advanced VNAV functionality supports speed restrictions and step-climb recommendations, while integrated takeoff and landing performance calculations account for aircraft weight, runway conditions and obstacle clearance.

Pilots will also benefit from a head-up display with synthetic vision, dedicated steep-approach mode, airport moving map and integrated weather radar.

CPDLC communications will be supported through Hoppie, SayIntentions and BeyondATC.

### Detailed Aircraft Systems

![](/assets/GlexTrailer2.png)

iniBuilds has confirmed detailed simulation of the aircraft's electrical, hydraulic and environmental systems, alongside an EPR-based engine and autothrottle model.

Nine system synoptic displays, electronic checklists and a comprehensive EFB provide access to aircraft monitoring, payload planning, failures and flight-management utilities.

### Interactive Cabins and Authentic Audio

![](/assets/GlexTrailer7.png)

Two fully interactive cabin configurations, **Classic** and **Futuristic**, will be included, featuring animated furnishings, adjustable lighting, window shades and selectable passenger modes.

Audio specialist Echo19 has also recorded the real aircraft's BR710 engines using more than ten microphones, with the recordings integrated into a detailed Wwise sound environment.

### What's Next?

iniBuilds has confirmed that a further video, *Welcome to the Global Jet*, is planned for next week. This will demonstrate cockpit preparation, FMS programming and the operation of the aircraft's avionics and systems.

![](/assets/GlexTrailer4.png)

No release date or pricing has been confirmed in this announcement.

With its extensive avionics, detailed systems simulation and immersive cabin features, the Global Jet is shaping up to be a particularly exciting addition to business aviation in MSFS 2024.

![](/assets/GlexTrailer9.png)
